summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Diageo plc for May 2026, containing standard UK regulatory announcements: total voting rights update as of 30 April 2026 and several Director/PDMR shareholding transactions (purchases under the company's share incentive plan) under UK Market Abuse Regulation. These are ordinary course of business disclosures, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender offer, or strategic change is reported. The filing serves as a periodic report of foreign private issuer and does not trigger any special-situations category. The voting rights update is a normal compliance item.
